test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, LRUP is written as RXAV and CILG is written as IORM. How will HNQL be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘LRUP is written as RXAV’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71e6ae05300a73a2d14b1c055637c3861f10f6d405bf3dcf1e7f318c1c18d5c8.png] 

For, 'CILG is written as IORM',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/896f5ee1916db5d576aafee3391fa40a89b8128b80fe748b88ad248c1de19ea0.png] 

Similarly, for '**HNQL**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/650622efd52a9bcbf3a95f540cb699ca7b1fc591cb8363a18964bcd42e15f0a7.png] 

So, 'HNQL' will be written as '**NTWR**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
